sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Advertising Business - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I've been thinking... Ragman's got a pretty nice thing going here. So I've got a little more work for you: I've got some guns that aren't exactly popular. They just keep piling up in storage, collecting dust. Show everyone a master class with one of them, make people want to get their hands on the same thing. I'll cut you in on the sales."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 30 enemies while using a T-5000M or RPDN in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +8,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.02
- 82,500 Roubles
- 30 GP coins
